description: Fetch one full conversation record, including all branches and metadata. The raw object is returned unchanged and hashed canonically before it is saved.
observation_recipe: open a conversation at https://chatgpt.com/c/{id} and record the conversation request
open a second conversation and confirm only the id in the path changes
verification_cases: identity: the requested id is the id in the path
payload: the raw object is preserved without field filtering
missing id: an empty id is rejected before a request is sent
auth failure: a 401 refreshes the session once, then stops the run
rate limit: a 429 retries with backoff and stops after the retry budget
